title: N-BEATS shared seasonality basis with factorized phase coordinates
hypothesis: A series-family plus calendar-regime additive phase address over a shared N-BEATS seasonal basis improves held-out role MASE over native shared coefficients, matched additive gain and common time shift, while using fewer role parameters than a flat per-role phase table.
physical_object: Pinned ServiceNow N-BEATS shared blocks and harmonic basis coefficients
mirror_coordinate: Additive factorized per-frequency phase shifts indexed by series-family and weekday/weekend regime
logical_multiplicity: Series x calendar-regime forecast functions from shared seasonal basis and role code

source.compatibility_patch: In isolated vendored copy, replace np.float with float for NumPy 2; record resulting patched source hash in verification.

data.dataset: ETTm1.csv for fitting and development; ETTm2.csv for untouched audit
data.dataset_provenance: ETTm1 reused from MA-1050 and development-only. Audit uses ETTm2 non-OT channels; its OT series was previously used by MA-1053, but these four channels were not evaluated there. Dataset is not a new independent benchmark family.
data.target_origin_definition: target_start; every target interval [target_start,target_start+horizon) must lie entirely inside its registered split
data.scale: Per-channel training-only mean/std; MASE denominator uses training seasonal lag 96
data.split: ETTm1: chronological first 60% train, next 20% development. ETTm2: final 20% target interval is audit; context may precede the audit start, targets may not. Audit is held from fitting and development selection.

amendments.reason: The first development run accidentally emitted ETTm1 audit metrics because the runner iterated both dev and audit in dev mode. Those outputs are preserved in runs/exploratory_invalidated and excluded from all selection and inference. ETTm1 audit is treated as exposed; audit targets moved to ETTm2 non-OT channels, not evaluated by the prior ETTm2 OT experiment.

model.stack: N-BEATS interpretable stack: 3 trend blocks and 3 seasonality blocks, 2 layers/block, width 128, Adam, batch size 32, 300 updates per model per seed
model.basis: Official TrendBasis degree 2 and SeasonalityBasis harmonics=3 with the upstream theta chunk ordering.
model.mirror_operator: Rotate forecast harmonic coefficient (cos_f,sin_f) pairs together for non-DC frequencies; do not rotate adjacent theta entries. For role c,r and band b, delta=delta_series[c,b]+delta_regime[r,b]. Preserve trend, DC, all backcasts and native network output.
model.phase_bands: fixed low/high frequency split at the median non-DC harmonic index; learn two phase values per series factor and two per regime factor (12 scalars total).

controls: Official native N-BEATS per-channel training (independent-series upper control)
N-BEATS shared across roles, no role address
Shared N-BEATS plus matched 2(C+R) additive log-gain seasonal coefficient control
Shared N-BEATS plus one common phase per band
Shared N-BEATS plus factorized series+regime phase address
Shared N-BEATS plus flat independent role phase table

development.selection_metric: Development MASE is a one-seed protocol calibration only; phase initialization scale is fixed at 0.25 radians, gain scale at 0.05, and no hyperparameter grid is searched.
development.limits: No audit predictions or metrics are accessed before source, split checks, control definitions, and selection choices are frozen. The development runner emits development rows only.

fresh.audit: ETTm2 final chronological segment, held-out to this experiment on HUFL/HULL/MUFL/MULL; no audit-based tuning.

success_gate: On untouched ETTm2 held-out channels, factorized phase improves pooled MASE by at least 2% over hard-share, matched gain and common-phase in at least 2/3 seeds, and role-state bytes are less than flat phase with full serialized bundle no larger than independent models.
failure_gate: Any success-gate criterion fails, or the Mirror coordinate aliases a matched native/simple parameterization without state or quality benefit.
boundaries: Single benchmark dataset reused from a prior MA; no independent-world claim.
Fixed-budget screen only; no capacity claim.
Harmonic phase rotation is representable by native N-BEATS coefficients.
